c2.skipped_reason: Deliberate, operator-informed. C2 answers a RELEASE question consumed by the Feature Release Gate, and an IN-SCOPE C2 finding can only AMEND a verdict, never produce one. The verdict is already FAIL on in-scope findings, so C2 could not change it, while costing ~24 runner dispatches on a session that had already hit the spend limit once. Recorded as not-assessed, NEVER as a pass.

business_rules_verified: BL-AUTH-012 - PASS. Org-scoped lock leaves the global account unlocked (/locked = false at V2 and V7). CORRECTION: its session half is refuted - an active-org lock does NOT evict live sessions (12 POST /graphql all 200 across two tabs). The lock gates new token issuance only. The model's L1 and the seeder's own banner both predicted otherwise.
BL-AUTH-013 - PASS. Org-scoped refusal carries error: invalid_grant plus a cause-specific code, never a global lockout code; exactly one errors[] entry.
BL-AUTH-015 - PASS. Resolution is not read-only; the write-back was observed moving CurrentOrganizationId.

BL-AUTH-016 - PASS with a CORRECTION. Fallback-first, lock-beats-status and single-error all hold. But clause 2's refusal branch is UNREACHABLE on a password grant: with zero accessible orgs the grant returns 200 with no org claim, not 400. BL-AUTH-015 wins. It IS reachable on a non-password grant.
BL-B2B-001 - PASS, all three legs. Cart, ship-to addresses and lists all reset on switch and restore on switch-back; pricing undecidable on this fixture and recorded as such.
BL-B2B-013 - PASS. Lock and status are independently assertable; the locked org appears under both statuses:[Locked] and statuses:[Approved].
BL-UI-002 - FAIL. Top utility bar overlaps itself at 1280 signed in.
